column1: # F2P bounding boxes — source-of-truth for F2pRegionDumperTest.
# Each row is a rectangular world-coordinate bounding box covering an
# F2P-accessible surface area. The dumper intersects these boxes with every
# surface-level OSRS map region (64x64 chunk) in the cache and emits a
# regionId -> tag TSV consumed by
# shortest-path/src/main/resources/f2p/regions.tsv.
# CLASSIFICATION RULE (differs from leagues_regions.tsv):
#   A SURFACE chunk (chunkY = regionId & 0xFF < 100, i.e. world y < 6400)
#   that overlaps ANY box below (overlap area >= 1 tile) is tagged F2P.
#   Every other loaded surface chunk is tagged MEMBERS.
#   Underground/instanced chunks (chunkY >= 100) are omitted from the
#   output entirely, which makes F2pRegionChecker return UNKNOWN for them
#   at runtime — UNKNOWN is treated as permissive (F2P-accessible). This
#   is intentional: F2P players can enter the Edgeville Dungeon, Varrock
#   Sewers, Dwarven Mine, etc. The membersOnly transport flag separately
#   prevents routing through members-only dungeon entrances.
# Wilderness fence note: F2P players can pass through the three gates at
# wilderness levels 47-48. Deep wilderness above the fence is members-only
# and falls outside the wilderness box below.
# Mudskipper Point note: the land is F2P-accessible; the fairy ring (AIQ)
# on the peninsula is a members-only transport and is filtered separately.
# Boxes are inclusive on both ends. Sources cross-checked against the
# OSRS wiki free-to-play article and transportation article.
# Format:
#   tag<TAB>xMin<TAB>xMax<TAB>yMin<TAB>yMax
# === Main F2P mainland (Misthalin + Asgarnia) ===
# Single broad box covers: Lumbridge (castle/swamp/cow field), Draynor
# (village/manor/sewers entrance), Wizards' Tower island, Varrock (city/
# GE/Champions' Guild/Earth Altar), Falador (both banks/party room/farm
# patch), Barbarian Village (Stronghold of Security entrance), Edgeville
# (bank/monastery/dungeon entrance/yew trees), Ice Mountain (Camdozaal
# stair), Goblin Village, Port Sarim (docks/jail/Entrana pier), Rimmington
# (Melzar's Maze entrance), Crafting Guild, Al Kharid (city/mine/tannery/
# Emir's Arena), Shantay Pass, Fire Altar ruins, Body/Mind/Water/Earth
# Altar ruins, and all connecting roads.
# A narrow sliver of Kharidian Desert at the south-east corner (x>3270,
# y<3130) is over-covered; those chunks have no F2P destinations so the
# pathfinder never routes through them.
F2P
# Mudskipper Point peninsula (south of Port Sarim, outside the main box).
# The surface land is F2P-accessible; the fairy ring transport is filtered
# by the membersOnly transport flag.
F2P
# Air Altar mysterious ruins (south-west of Falador, outside main box x).
# The corridor from Falador west heading south-west to the ruins is F2P.
F2P
# === Wilderness (F2P up to the fence at levels 47-48) ===
# F2P players can reach wilderness levels 47-48 via three gates in the
# fence. Deep wilderness above the fence (Resource Area, Mage Arena,
# God Wars Dungeon) is members-only and starts above y≈3904.
# Notable F2P spots: Ferox Enclave (3128, 3631), Hobgoblin Mine (~3300,
# 3820), moss giant spawns (~3230, 3838), Lava Dragon Isle (~3215, 3855).
# The KBD trapdoor (~3017, 3850) and similar dungeon entrances are gated
# by members-only transport flags — the surface chunks are walkable F2P.
F2P
# === Karamja (F2P portions only) ===
# Musa Point: gangplank landing, banana plantation strip, customs officer.
# The jungle further south/west is members territory.
F2P
# West Karamja coast: Crandor & Karamja Dungeon surface entrance.
F2P
# Crandor island (Dragon Slayer I quest island).
F2P
# === Corsair Cove (after starting The Corsair Curse quest) ===
# Excludes Myth's Guild area (members; sits at ~2454, 2845).
F2P
